mechanism: Methylphenidate may increase sympathomimetic effects that antagonize glucose-lowering effects of glyburide, potentially reducing glycemic control; glyburide is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 with minor CYP450 involvement from methylphenidate.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely; patient may require glyburide dose adjustment; counsel on awareness of hyperglycemia symptoms.
